Background:
Marianne von Edmund was born into nobility in the Leicester Alliance, a confederacy of noble houses led by the Five Great Lords, one of whom is Marianne’s own adopted father. Marianne was taken in by her distant relative at House Edmund when she was fourteen years old after the tragic deaths of her parents. Marianne believed these deaths to be the result of a curse on her family in the form of the Crest of Maurice, otherwise known as the Crest of the Beast, that was said to bring misfortune to its bearers and transform them into monstrous, savage beasts that would kill any who encountered them. These legends, unfounded as they may be, affected Marianne greatly, leading to a severe self-loathing and the tendency to put others before herself in all situations.

Marianne became a student at the Garreg Mach Monastery Officers Academy in the Golden Deer house with fellow Leicester Alliance citizens. Here, she practices her Faith and Riding skills under the tutelage of Professor Byleth and takes part in the events that play out due to the rising tensions between the Adrestrian Empire and the rest of Fodlan.

Personality:
Marianne is a gloomy, unsociable individual, who believes herself to be a bringer of misfortune to all those around her. She spends most of her time alone and is rarely known to even speak in public. Marianne has a deep seated disdain towards herself due to the perceived curse she bears in the form of her Crest, and does what she can to avoid inconveniencing or otherwise disturbing those around her. She finds it difficult to express herself to other people, favoring spending time with animals instead, and desperately tries to keep the truth of her Crest hidden from everyone due to the stigma surrounding it. Despite the distance she keeps from others, Marianne is actually a kind-hearted and gentle spirit who listens to and cares deeply for her peers.

Marianne is something of a recluse due to her fear of having the secret of her Crest exposed. Most of her time is spent either tending to the animals on the Monastery grounds or praying to the goddess in the church. To Marianne, her animal friends are the only ones who will accept her for who she is, and the goddess is the only one who could ever free her from the curse she lives with. Marianne’s isolation and self-loathing have developed into a depression that impacts her life, leading to her lack of self-care and an excessive sense of guilt about her very existence. Despite everything, her friends in the Golden Deer and her professor have begun to break through her shell and form bonds that Marianne can rely on, shining a light through her gloom that can lead her to happier days.


Targetable Qualities:
Depression and/or suicidal ideation
Love of animals
Pious faith and worship
Camaraderie and friendship on the battlefield
Nobility and the duty it carries
Her supposed curse

Touchstones:
Sad girlfailure
Devout priestess and holy warrior
Talks to animals (and understands them)
Clumsy and bad at being tidy
